question:
Which term from among the given options can replace the question mark (?) in the following series to make it logically complete?

D 13 Q, F 17 R, ?, J 25 T, L 29 U
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First and third letter → (2) and (1) are added to the position value of first and third letter according to English alphabetic series respectively.
 
• Number → (4) is added to each number.

So,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c627863b93e005a014ef5c78fdae0a0dce7d0339729d935f55abff8c8aad706c.png] 

​Hence, "**H 21 S**" is the correct answer.
